interaction.model_cot: Release decision: v0.5.0 (minor bump) because the delta is a user-visible capability plus deliberate behavior changes: linker worktree scoping, bare-repo cvc run refusal, MCP startup binding, extension trust/single-folder requirements. All six version locations bumped plus internal cvc-core dependency specs; Cargo.lock and plugin package-lock regenerated. Full runbook battery green locally: rust fmt/clippy/test/check, plugin including VS Code integration tests on the real display (no xvfb needed), reviewer 37 tests plus build, npm wrapper, third-party notices current (428 packages), version gate matched all 6 manifests. Release body docs/releases/v0.5.0.md documents additive DB migration with mixed-version safety, unchanged v5 wire format, and carries known limitations 39 (range identity across worktrees) and 40 (capture contention) transparently. UAT of the task-terminal consent flow passed (user-verified). Tagging, external registry availability checks, and environment approvals remain with the release authority per RELEASING.md.
